query:
Two members expressed the view that participants should read the game rules before arriving at a session. Which member made the more specific, procedural version of this argument — specifying how and when it should happen?

Options:
A. Tomasz
B. Derek
C. Marcus
D. Raj
context:
[1] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:03:00) Good. In my experience, we should decide the game before the night so people can read the rules. Nothing worse than spending the first hour on a rules explanation.
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:05:00) Seconded. If we're playing something new, whoever owns it should send the rulebook link by Wednesday. Cuts setup time by at least 30 minutes.
[3] (about=Derek, episodic, t0 @2026-03-02T19:04:00) agree. read the rules people
[4] (about=Derek, episodic, t4 @2026-03-09T19:01:00) read it. lets go
[5] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) Keeps a spreadsheet tracking game statistics, including win/loss records.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) If playing a new game, owner must send rulebook link by Wednesday to cut setup time.
[7] (about=Nadia, core, t2 @2026-04-06T19:00:00) Agrees that agreeing up front is the correct qualifier for house rules, viewing it as a pre-session variant declaration rather than a rulebook violation.
[8] (about=Nadia, core, t12 @2026-04-13T19:01:00) Played a four-session wargame campaign with Tomasz over six weeks last April, describing it as the most precise rules environment she has played in.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t14 @2026-04-20T19:01:00) Bring-something rule for marathon: bring a game or food, both ideal; enforcement via social pressure.
[10] (about=Tomasz, core, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) Prefers games with shorter rules overhead for new members; suggests revisiting Oath later when everyone has baseline.
[11] (about=Tomasz, core, t1 @2026-03-06T19:32:00) Normally opposes house rules on principle, but supports one quality-of-life adjustment for new members after a session two months ago where a new player left mid-game due to punishing worker placement.
agent_answer:
Marcus made the more specific, procedural version: he specified that for a new game, the owner should send the rulebook link by **Wednesday**.  
Tomasz only suggested deciding the game before the night so people could read the rules; Derek simply agreed (“read the rules people”). Raj has no record on this.
